# SCI-POINT Author Formal-Error-Method Extract

Identity: `POINT-FORMAL-ERROR-METHOD v0.1`

State: `unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval`

This authority is scientifically and lifecycle-distinct from
`POINT-COMPATIBILITY-METHOD`. Its absence does not erase an otherwise
authorized numerical fit.

The future exact record must bind fitted parameterization, stochastic
covariance/residual model, relation to fit weights, exact curvature/profile/
sandwich or other construction, observed versus expected curvature, residual
scaling, degrees of freedom, rank and positive-definiteness requirements,
parameter transformations, marginal extraction, active bounds, circular and
axis-exchange degeneracy, weak identification, rank deficiency, finite/
positive/consistency checks, units, conditional scope, omitted uncertainty,
and unavailable/failed states.

Until that record is content-bound and owner-approved:

- marginal formal errors are unavailable;
- joint covariance is unavailable unless a separate authority supplies it;
- `fitted_amplitude_over_formal_amplitude_error` and alias `fit_sig2noise`
  are unavailable;
- named uses requiring formal uncertainty fail closed; and
- products and uses not requiring formal uncertainty are not erased merely by
  its absence.

Finite optimizer covariance is not authority. Missing uncertainty does not
mean zero uncertainty, diagonal covariance, or independence.
